$comment: AUTHORITY for what a service that reads a configuration document writes when it will not start on that document or on its environment: `line`, once, to stderr, with the refusal in place of `{refusal}`, and then it exits with `exitCode` without ever serving. `services` is each service that refuses so; each refusal is one of `refusals`, word for word, with each `{name}` filled as the row's `situation` says and nothing else varying. `{service}` is the service's name, as `services` writes it, and `{schema}` its document's schema: `GatewayConfig`, `ArchivistConfig` or `DispatcherConfig`. The refusals are checked in the order they are listed, and the first that fails is the one written. A refusal never carries a value of the document or of the environment: it names members and variables.

refusals.name: unnamed
refusals.situation: Started without `--config <path>` or `--config=<path>` naming a path.
refusals.refusal: The {service}'s configuration document is not named: start it with --config <path>

refusals.name: unreadable
refusals.situation: The path names no file the service can read: `{path}` is the path as it was given, and `{reason}` the system's reason, which varies.
refusals.refusal: Cannot read the {service}'s configuration document at {path} ({reason}). The launcher writes it; a {service} started another way is given one ({schema} in protocol/specs/).

refusals.name: not-json
refusals.situation: The file is not JSON: `{path}` is the path as it was given, and `{reason}` the parser's reason, which varies.

refusals.name: invalid
refusals.situation: The document is not its schema's: `{path}` is the path as it was given, and `{members}` is one line of `members` for each way it is not, each on a line of its own.

refusals.name: no-service-account
refusals.situation: `XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` or `XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` is unset or empty: `{missing}` is each that is, in that order, joined by ` and `.
refusals.refusal:
{missing} not set — this {service} has no service account to sign in with.
The launcher passes both for each service it starts; a {service} started another way needs the client its realm registers for it (XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=xynolog-{service}).

refusals.name: unset
refusals.situation: A member of the document names an environment variable that is unset or empty: `{field}` is the member's JSON pointer, and `{name}` the variable.
refusals.refusal: {field} names the environment variable {name}, which is not set

members.name: missing
members.situation: An object without a member its schema requires: `{pointer}` is the object's JSON pointer, `/` for the document itself, and `{member}` the member.

members.name: undeclared
members.situation: An object with members its schema does not declare: `{pointer}` is the object's JSON pointer, `/` for the document itself, and `{members}` the members, joined by `, `.

members.name: other
members.situation: Any other way a member is not its schema's: `{pointer}` is the member's JSON pointer, and `{why}` the validator's words, which vary and never carry the member's value.
